records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended April 3, 2021, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change in twelve-month backlog at April 3, 2021 compared with March 28, 2020 was driven by increases in our military aircraft and our defense markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Backlog increased in Aircraft Controls due to additional military development programs and due to the production ramp and associated orders for the F-35 program.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin decreased slightly in the second quarter and the first half of 2021 compared to the same periods of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity and our cash flow from operations have provided us with the financial resources needed to make organic investments, fund acquisitive growth and return capital to shareholders.
